image_description: Two black grouse (blackcocks) on a grassy field. The bird in the foreground is displaying, with its tail fanned out to reveal bright white undertail coverts and dark outer feathers. It has glossy black plumage. A second blackcock is visible in the background to the right, showing a red eyebrow comb.
